caption:
Your voicemail is where leads go to die.

Most callers who reach voicemail don't leave one. They hang up and call the next business on Google.

Fix it this week. Rerecord your greeting with three parts:
1. Acknowledge the miss
2. Redirect them to text the same number
3. Set a real reply time

Example: "Thanks for calling [Business]. We're on a job right now. Text this number and tell us what you need, we reply within 15 minutes."

Then call your own line from a second phone. Listen for all three parts. Confirm the number in the greeting matches the one that receives texts.

Want that redirect running the second a call goes unanswered?

rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience teaching, and this fills Education with a genuinely unclaimed fix (the voicemail greeting script itself) distinct from every prior missed-call text-back copy, booking-link, and walkthrough angle already shipped.
